thesis: AMD has a real product cycle arriving - MI400 ships in the second half of 2026 - but the stock is up 190% in a year and the revenue behind the thesis is forecast, not delivered. More to the point for this desk, we already own NVDA, MSFT and XLK: AMD is a fourth expression of the same AI trade in a book that has no room left. Owning it is fine; adding AI beta here is not.
bull_case: The MI400 series - Instinct MI450 plus the Helios rack-scale platform - launches in 2H 2026 and is estimated at roughly $7.2B of 2026 revenue, about 25% of data-centre sales, on around 258,000 units at an ASP near $30,900. Data-centre GPU revenue is forecast to rise 114% to $15B and total data-centre revenue 73% to $28.7B in 2026. Management frames this as a broad attack across inference, training and agentic computing rather than one product. The market has been paying for it: shares are up 189.7% over 52 weeks, from $473.25 on 21 August to $503.60 now. Packet: score +0.46, close > SMA50 > SMA200, 63d momentum +11.3%, RSI 61.
bear_case: Every number in the bull case is a forecast. MI400 has not shipped in volume, and a second-half launch means the revenue lands mostly beyond this horizon while the multiple already reflects it after a 190% year. ATR of 3.7% is among the widest in the book, so the 1% risk rule buys a small position with a wide stop - poor use of the last of our cash. The concentration objection is the strongest one: NVDA, MSFT and XLK are already in the book, and XLK alone holds NVDA at about 16%, so AMD is the fourth overlapping claim on AI capex. Macro turned hawkish again today: CME FedWatch has the odds of a hike next week back to 62.2%, up from roughly 49-51% yesterday, with PPI out today and August CPI tomorrow morning as the last inflation reads before the 15-16 Sep FOMC. Brent is $101.25 after US forces destroyed five Iranian tankers and Houthi strikes hit Saudi energy facilities.
catalysts: Q3 2026 results and data-centre GPU revenue against the $15B path
August CPI on 11 Sep and the 15-16 Sep FOMC
Hyperscaler commitments to Helios rack-scale deployments
risks: Thesis rests on forecast rather than delivered MI400 revenue
+189.7% over 52 weeks: a great deal already priced
Fourth overlapping AI position alongside NVDA, MSFT and XLK
ATR 3.7% - wide stop, small position, poor capital efficiency
Hike odds back to 62.2% into a high-multiple semiconductor
invalidation: Flips long on a daily close above 545 - a new high confirming the MI400 cycle is being paid for rather than debated. The bear case confirms on a close below 470, the August base, which breaks the SMA50 structure.
